title: Bhakti SF
specs: Spiritual community space rooted in Bhakti Yoga focusing on devotion, connection, music, service, and self-discovery
Classes include elements of breathwork, meditation, mantra, and sound healing
Community dinners are an important part of Bhakti culture
No experience needed; classes and events are beginner-friendly and accessible to all
All ages, backgrounds, and beliefs are welcome

services.desc: Learn how to create fresh, flavorful vegetarian meals with hands-on classes designed for every skill level. Whether you’re new to vegetarian cooking or looking to expand your recipe collection, our classes make it easy to cook with confidence. Each session focuses on approachable techniques, seasonal ingredients, and satisfying meals that are both nourishing and full of flavor. You’ll learn practical kitchen skills, discover new ingredient combinations, and leave with recipes you can recreate at home for family and friends. Our welcoming, interactive classes are designed to be fun, relaxed, and inspiring - the perfect place to explore plant-based
